title: Tax amendment bill passed in Lok Sabha: What changes for UPI transactions, offshore fund norms
content:
• The Lok Sabha on 6 August passed a Bill amending the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, empowering the government to allow banks and service providers to levy charges (MDR) on UPI and other electronic payment modes.
• The Taxation and other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, which replaces a June 5 Ordinance, amends the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, the Income Tax Act, 2025, and the Finance Act, 2026.
• The Bill proposes to keep dividends from business trusts (REITs and InvITs) tax-free for investors and extends tax exemption for foreign companies supplying machinery for electronics manufacturing by 10 years to 2040-41.

title: Donald Trump signs fresh executive orders to limit birthright citizenship in US after Supreme Court pushback
content:
• US President Donald Trump signed new executive orders to limit birthright citizenship in the United States.
• Trump's previous effort to limit birthright citizenship was rejected by the US Supreme Court (SCOTUS) on June 30.
• An analysis by the US Center for Immigration Studies reported that 20,000 to 25,000 mothers entered the US for 'birth tourism' during 2016-2017.

title: India successfully test-fires nuclear-capable Agni-4 ballistic missile off Odisha coast
content:
• India successfully test-fired the nuclear-capable Agni-4 medium-range ballistic missile off the Odisha coast, from the Integrated Test Range (ITR) in Chandipur.
• The Agni-4 ballistic missile possesses a strike range of approximately 4,000 kilometres.
• The missile was developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and its recent launch was conducted under the aegis of the Strategic Forces Command.

title: Strait of Hormuz deal imminent: Is US prepared to back bigger role for Iran? Explained
content:
• A proposed temporary shipping arrangement between Iran and Oman for the Strait of Hormuz will involve "no fees or tolls" for inbound and outbound traffic.
• A memorandum of understanding was signed between Iran and the US on 17 June, expecting Tehran to allow commercial vessels to transit the Strait of Hormuz without charges for 60 days, in return for Washington lifting its naval blockade.
• The temporary shipping arrangement between Iran and Oman for the Strait of Hormuz could remain valid for "two to four months" and is expected to involve the United Nations’ International Maritime Organisation (IMO) and the US in its announcement.

title: FM Nirmala Sitharaman hits back at Jairam Ramesh over UPI taxation: Social media reacts, ‘When I sell my kidney…’
content:
• The new Taxation and Other Laws Amendment Bill proposes amending Section 10A of the Payment Act to allow banks and service providers to charge fees on UPI transactions, replacing the current zero-MDR framework.
• Jairam Ramesh cited RBI's ₹2.86 lakh crore surplus transfer for 2025-26, claiming it could fund UPI infrastructure without imposing additional fees.
• Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that the NPCI-led steering committee will decide the specifics of MDR implementation only after the Taxation and Other Laws Amendment Bill passes.

title: RBI defers loan recovery norms till Jan as lenders seek more time
content:
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has deferred the implementation of its guidelines on loan recovery and engagement of recovery agents by three months, making the new effective date 1 January 2027.
• The RBI clarified that its new loan recovery directions, including the definitions of 'recovery agency' and 'recovery agent', would not apply to the lenders' own employees.
• RBI has directed banks to establish a dedicated mechanism for the redressal of recovery-related grievances, requiring details to be provided in loan agreements and all recovery communications.

title: Tariff rationalisation set to continue, more steps likely in FY28 Budget: FM
content:
• India's simple average tariff stood at 15.8% in 2025, according to World Trade Organization data.
• In the budget for 2026-27, FM Sitharaman announced basic customs duty exemptions to strengthen energy security and boost civil and defence aviation manufacturing.
• The vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047 envisages zero poverty, universal access to quality education and affordable healthcare, skilled youth, and greater participation of women in economic activity.

title: Parl panel for early conclusion of India-US trade pact, tariff exemptions on key goods
content:
• India and the US aim to more than double total bilateral trade to $500 billion by 2030.
• A parliamentary panel has recommended the early conclusion of the proposed Bilateral Trade Agreement (BTA) between India and the US.
• The panel suggested reducing US tariffs on Indian engineering goods, auto components, and other automotive products, and fast-tracking Mutual Recognition Agreements (MRAs) for professional services, pharmaceuticals, and agricultural standards.

title: India may rationalise most customs tariffs by Budget 2027-28, Nirmala Sitharaman says
content:
• India plans to rationalise most customs tariffs.
• The rationalisation of customs tariffs is targeted to be completed by Budget 2027-28.
• Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced this plan on Thursday.

title: Lok Sabha passes Bill enabling Centre to allow UPI charges, MDR on digital payments
content:
• The Lok Sabha passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, empowering the central government to notify digital payment modes on which charges, including Merchant Discount Rate (MDR), may be permitted in the future.
• The amendment specifically removes the existing legal provision that barred banks and payment system providers from imposing Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on notified electronic payment modes.
• Currently, Section 269SU of the Income Tax Act requires businesses with an annual turnover of more than Rs 50 crore to offer specified digital payment options like BHIM-UPI and RuPay debit cards, which are presently exempt from MDR.
